newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary March retail turnover up 5.1 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Hungary March retail turnover up 5.1 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Hungary's retail and catering turnover rose 5.1 percent in March from February, but was down four percent in year-on-year terms, the Central Statistical Office said in a statement on Friday.
Hungary's retail turnover totalled 570 billion forints in the first quarter of the year, 10 percent down from the same period of 1996, the KSH said.
The turnover of catering totalled 50 billion forints in the January-March period, up 7.4 percent year-on-year, it added.
